Name: Meadow Ranch Farm
Author: Lavliette
Description:
An old map I decided to update and share with you. It's mostly meant as a Farm for lots of animals, but you can plant crops as well. 
(The cave entry is set a bit higher than Vanilla, so it might look a bit weird when entering the cave.)


• All grass is tillable 
• Replaces the Forest Farm


[u][b]Requirements[/b]
[/u]• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• Daisyniko's Tilesheets


[u][b]Installation[/b]
[/u]• Install the Requirements
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [CP] Meadow Ranch Farm into your Mods 
• Run the game with Smapi and select the Forest Farm 

Enjoy!
